_meta.description: School/college and university graduation requirements that apply on top of a program's own requirements. Each rule is transcribed from the Temple Academic Bulletin page named by its layer and carries a verbatim 'evidence' quote. The ingest script and the Requirements Research Agent check every quote against the fetched page; a rule whose quote is no longer on the page is downgraded to AMBIGUOUS.
_meta.kinds: count/credits: schedulable course rules. milestone: computed from the record (metric: total_credits | upper_level_credits | temple_credits | gpa). policy: shown to the student, not computed.
_meta.applies: types: program types the layer applies to; degrees: program-id degree suffix (ba, bs, bba, ...); name_matches / name_excludes: regex on program name; exclude: program ids.
